visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older man with short graying hair and glasses, wearing a dark quilted vest over a gray long-sleeved shirt, sits relaxed on a cream-colored fabric sofa. To his left, a ginger and white cat sits perched on a white end table with a black glass top. The background is a white wall decorated with a large framed traditional Chinese ink painting of flowers, illuminated by soft, bright indoor lighting. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of the ginger and white cat on the end table. The cat has alert ears and white whiskers. A hand enters from the side, gently petting the cat's head and neck. The cat visibly relaxes, squinting its eyes and tilting its head into the palm of the hand. Yellow variety-show style text and icons pop up on the screen periodically. (3) The cat moves from the cabinet onto the man's lap. The man smiles warmly, his eyes crinkling behind his glasses as he continues to pet the cat's back with a rhythmic motion. The scene remains in the domestic living room setting with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The man's posture is casual as he interacts with the pet. (4) Close-up shot focusing on the cat lying comfortably on the man's dark-colored trousers. The man's hands are seen gently patting the cat's rump. The cat appears sleepy and content. In the final sequence, a yellow arrow points toward the cat's belly, accompanied by a concluding text slogan at the bottom of the frame against the background of the living room.
